arms.original: Unchanged complete_grow original candidate membership and selection; must reproduce retained baseline.
arms.eligible_links: Subset with at least one shared sense link whose source and target terms both have eligible=true and whose complete target form has target_safe=true. Retain nonexplicit direct-English links. Do not require source_safe, shared POS, or arbitrary one-sense status. No new target or reranking.
arms.apple_disagreement_veto: eligible_links minus candidates with an exact single-token mapped Apple lexical role incompatible with every linked source POS; unknown/unassessed evidence remains baseline, explicitly not approved.
arms.apple_role_required: eligible_links restricted to exact single-token mapped Apple lexical role compatible with a linked source POS; unknown/composite/multitoken evidence abstains.
arms.opennlp_disagreement_veto: Same disagreement-only policy with frozen OpenNLP annotations.
arms.opennlp_role_required: Same role-required policy with frozen OpenNLP annotations.

annotation_policy: Original current message only; no prior dialogue, targets or labels.
Exact candidate focus equals one original annotation token; no guessed head for multiple tokens.
Other tags including PROPN and composites are unassessed. No fuzzy named-entity veto.
Raw confidence retained for diagnostics; no confidence threshold or semantic authorization.
No target-POS equality imposed: complete cross-category translations may be valid. Only source role is compared to eligible source term POS.
Unknown left unchanged in disagreement-only arm is not safety approval. All arms remain research.
selection_invariants: Candidate identities/faces/order, native geometry, density, known states, original source and historical masks remain fixed.
Use exact existing selector before budget; masks survive filtered candidates.
Never backfill a new target variant when same-face or a role conflict removes a candidate. Other already-existing disjoint candidates may be selected by unchanged budget policy; retain those deltas.
Original corpus strict-containing masks remain weaker than native exact-overlap permission admission.
Do not label linked dictionary senses as exhaustive source meanings.
Source-only role features cannot resolve titles, idioms, same-POS senses or target inflection.
outputs: Counts by pair/arm/known state: candidate rejection/unknown, raw displayed content/function coverage, changed/content depth, baseline deltas.
Retained exact selected IDs/ranges and added/removed outputs, plus link evidence for role decisions.
A separately frozen deterministic diagnostic review selection will cover changed whole outputs and controls before meaning labels. No correct-coverage result until reviewed.
execution_binding_required: Verify actual Apple/OpenNLP annotation outputs and matching original source digests for all9535 IDs before projection.
Freeze projector code hash and actual annotation hashes before executing.
Projection source/metadata failures retain original failure; no silent widened guard or new target.
relation_to_prior_contract: Additive fixed-pool diagnostic refinement: explicit metadata-only control, separate unknown-preserving and unknown-abstaining POS arms. Proposed entity/idiom arm C is not included and no invented guard is substituted.
